- Affinity can't handle `svg` file with custom CSS. It's usually shown as the imported `svg` file seems completely black. See [here](https://forum.affinity.serif.com/index.php?/topic/136944-svg-imports-as-black/). Easiest solution is to use `eps` file in the upstream work.
